stem: The cells in a tissue are often at different stages of the cell cycle.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: Identify the stages of mitosis occurring in the cells labelled B and C in Fig. 1.1.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Describe the behaviour of the chromosomes in the stage of mitosis shown in cell A in Fig. 1.1.

parts.label: (a)(iii)
parts.text:
Cell D in Fig. 1.1 is in interphase.
Describe the role of DNA ligase in interphase.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem:
Telomerase is an enzyme that is active during interphase in some cells.
Telomerase helps to maintain telomeres present on chromosomes.
parts.text: State the location of telomeres on a chromosome.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
Some people with a long lifespan have cells showing a higher than normal activity of telomerase.
Suggest why a long lifespan could result from a higher telomerase activity.
